question: Identify the state abbreviations where, for both male and female legislators, the retention rate remains greater than zero at specific intervals of 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 years after their first term start date. A legislator is considered retained if they are serving on December 31 of the respective year. Only include states where both gender cohorts maintain non-zero retention rates at all six of these time points during the first decade of service.
sql:
WITH legislator_first_term AS (
    SELECT 
        l.id_bioguide,
        l.gender,
        MIN(lt.term_start) as first_term_start,
        lt.state
    FROM legislators l
    JOIN legislators_terms lt ON l.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
    WHERE lt.term_number = 0 AND lt.term_start IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY l.id_bioguide, l.gender, lt.state
),
years_interval AS (
    SELECT 0 as years_elapsed UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 10
),
legislator_check_dates AS (
    SELECT 
        lft.id_bioguide,
        lft.gender,
        lft.state,
        lft.first_term_start,
        y.years_elapsed,
        CAST(lft.first_term_start AS DATE) + INTERVAL '1 year' * y.years_elapsed as check_date
    FROM legislator_first_term lft
    CROSS JOIN years_interval y
),
legislator_serving AS (
    SELECT 
        lcd.id_bioguide,
        lcd.gender,
        lcd.state,
        lcd.years_elapsed,
        lcd.check_date,
        CASE 
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt 
                WHERE lt.id_bioguide = lcd.id_bioguide 
                AND lt.state = lcd.state
                AND (CAST(t.term_start AS DATE) <= lcd.check_date AND CAST(t.term_end AS DATE) >= lcd.check_date)
            ) THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END as is_retained
    FROM legislator_check_dates lcd
    JOIN legislators_terms t ON lcd.id_bioguide = t.id_bioguide AND lcd.state = t.state
),
retention_rates AS (
    SELECT 
        state,
        gender,
        years_elapsed,
        SUM(is_retained) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) as retention_rate
    FROM legislator_serving
    GROUP BY state, gender, years_elapsed
)
SELECT * FROM retention_rates 
WHERE state = 'AK'
ORDER BY gender, years_elapsed
